From the owner
Take a look at one of our latest completed kitchen remodeling projects in Beaverton, Oregon. For this smaller kitchen, we kept the existing footprint while improving the space with custom maple Shaker cabinets, Citrine quartz countertops, a full-height tile backsplash, better corner storage, and a custom matching hutch for the adjoining dining area. The project is a great example of how thoughtful kitchen design can make an existing space more functional without requiring a complete change in layout. See the finished kitchen, project details, and real-world pricing in our latest project feature.
Sep 21, 2026
